description: This file defines the M2MRelationship class, which manages many-to-many relationships between modules in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for adding, removing, and querying relationships, as well as handling relationship links and table details.

classes.name: M2MRelationship
classes.description: Represents a many-to-many relationship that is table-based, with methods to manage relationship entries such as add, remove, and load, and to generate SQL queries for related modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship object based on the provided definition, setting linked module definitions and relationship details.

methods.name: getLinkedDefForModuleByRelationship
methods.description: Finds the link definition for a given module related to this relationship.

methods.name: getMostAppropriateLinkedDefinition
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate link entry when multiple links exist with the same relationship name.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a link between two beans (records), handling security groups and self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: getRowToInsert
methods.description: Constructs a data array for inserting a new relationship row.

methods.name: addSelfReferencing
methods.description: Adds a reverse relationship entry for self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a relationship link between two beans, including security considerations and self-referencing cleanup.

methods.name: removeSelfReferencing
methods.description: Removes the reversed relationship entry for self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads related beans through the relationship link.

methods.name: linkIsLHS
methods.description: Checks if the given link is on the left-hand side of the relationship.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Generates an SQL query to fetch related records based on the relationship.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Creates SQL JOIN statements for related module tables adhering to relationship links.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Constructs subpanel queries for related modules based on the relationship.

methods.name: getRoleFilterForJoin
methods.description: Generates SQL filters based on relationship role columns.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship link exists between two beans.

methods.name: getAlternateKeyFields
methods.description: Returns fields that uniquely identify an entry in this relationship, considering role columns.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the relationship table used for this relationship.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the database fields involved in this relationship.
